CFCalendarUnit.doc: CFCalendarUnit constants are used to specify calendrical units, such as day or month, in various calendar calculations.

kCFCalendarUnitWeekOfMonth.doc: Specifies the original week of a month calendar unit.

kCFCalendarUnitWeekOfYear.doc: Specifies the original week of the year calendar unit.

kCFCalendarUnitYearForWeekOfYear.doc: Specifies the relative year for a week within a year calendar unit.

kCFCharacterSetAlphaNumeric.doc: Alpha Numeric character set (Unicode General Category L*, M*, & N*).

kCFCharacterSetCapitalizedLetter.doc: Titlecase character set (Unicode General Category Lt).

kCFCharacterSetControl.doc: Control character set (Unicode General Category Cc and Cf).

kCFCharacterSetLetter.doc: Letter character set (Unicode General Category L* & M*).

kCFCharacterSetLowercaseLetter.doc: Lowercase character set (Unicode General Category Ll).

kCFCharacterSetNewline.doc: Newline character set (U000A ~ U000D, U0085, U2028, and U2029).

kCFCharacterSetNonBase.doc: Non-base character set (Unicode General Category M*).

kCFCharacterSetPunctuation.doc: Punctuation character set (Unicode General Category P*).

kCFCharacterSetSymbol.doc: Symbol character set (Unicode General Category S*).

kCFCharacterSetUppercaseLetter.doc: Uppercase character set (Unicode General Category Lu and Lt).

kCFCharacterSetWhitespace.doc: Whitespace character set (Unicode General Category Zs and U0009 CHARACTER TABULATION).

kCFCharacterSetWhitespaceAndNewline.doc: Whitespace and Newline character set (Unicode General Category Z*, U000A ~ U000D, and U0085).

CFComparisonResult.doc: Constants returned by comparison functions, indicating whether a value is equal to, less than, or greater than another value.

kCFCompareEqualTo.doc: Returned by a comparison function if the first value is equal to the second value.

kCFCompareGreaterThan.doc: Returned by a comparison function if the first value is greater than the second value.

kCFCompareLessThan.doc: Returned by a comparison function if the first value is less than the second value.

CFDataSearchFlags.doc: A CFOptionFlags type for specifying options for searching.

CFDateFormatterStyle.doc: Data type for predefined date and time format styles.

kCFDateFormatterFullStyle.doc: Specifies a full style with complete details, such as “Tuesday, April 12, 1952 AD” or “3:30:42pm PST”.

kCFDateFormatterLongStyle.doc: Specifies a long style, typically with full text, such as “November 23, 1937” or “3:30:32pm”.

kCFDateFormatterMediumStyle.doc: Specifies a medium style, typically with abbreviated text, such as “Nov 23, 1937”.

kCFDateFormatterShortStyle.doc: Specifies a short style, typically numeric only, such as “11/23/37” or “3:30pm”.

kCFFileSecurityClearGroupUUID.doc: Clear the group UUID (for the access control list).

kCFFileSecurityClearOwnerUUID.doc: Clear the owner UUID (for the access control list).

CFGregorianUnitFlags.doc: These option flags are used as a mask to indicate a specific set of fields in the CFGregorianDate or CFGregorianUnits structures.

CFLocaleLanguageDirection.doc: These constants describe the text direction for a language. They are returned by the functions CFLocaleGetLanguageCharacterDirection and CFLocaleGetLanguageLineDirection.

CFNotificationSuspensionBehavior.doc: Suspension flags that indicate how distributed notifications should be handled when the receiving application is in the background.

CFNotificationSuspensionBehaviorCoalesce.doc: The server will only queue the last notification of the specified name and object; earlier notifications are dropped.

CFNotificationSuspensionBehaviorDeliverI.doc: The server will deliver notifications of the specified name and object whether or not the application is in the background. When a notification with this suspension behavior is matched, it has the effect of first flushing any queued notifications.

CFNotificationSuspensionBehaviorDrop.doc: The server will not queue any notifications of the specified name and object while the receiving application is in the background.

CFNotificationSuspensionBehaviorHold.doc: The server will hold all matching notifications until the queue has been filled (queue size determined by the server) at which point the server may flush queued notifications.

CFNumberFormatterOptionFlags.doc: Type for constants specifying how numbers should be parsed.

kCFNumberFormatterParseIntegersOnly.doc: Specifies that only integers should be parsed.

CFNumberFormatterPadPosition.doc: Type for constants specifying how numbers should be padded.

kCFNumberFormatterPadAfterPrefix.doc: Specifies the number of padding characters after the prefix.

kCFNumberFormatterPadAfterSuffix.doc: Specifies the number of padding characters after the suffix.

kCFNumberFormatterPadBeforePrefix.doc: Specifies the number of padding characters before the prefix.

kCFNumberFormatterPadBeforeSuffix.doc: Specifies the number of padding characters before the suffix.

CFNumberFormatterRoundingMode.doc: These constants are used to specify how numbers should be rounded.

kCFNumberFormatterRoundHalfDown.doc: Round towards the nearest integer, or towards zero if equidistant.

kCFNumberFormatterRoundHalfEven.doc: Round towards the nearest integer, or towards an even number if equidistant.

kCFNumberFormatterRoundHalfUp.doc: Round towards the nearest integer, or away from zero if equidistant.

CFNumberFormatterStyle.doc: Type for constants specifying a formatter style.

CFNumberType.doc: Flags used by CFNumber to indicate the data type of a value.

kCFNumberFloat32Type.doc: Thirty-two-bit real. The Float32 data type is defined in MacTypes.h.

kCFNumberFloat64Type.doc: Sixty-four-bit real. The Float64 data type is defined in MacTypes.h and conforms to the 64-bit IEEE 754 standard.

kCFNumberSInt16Type.doc: Sixteen-bit, signed integer. The SInt16 data type is defined in MacTypes.h.

kCFNumberSInt32Type.doc: Thirty-two-bit, signed integer. The SInt32 data type is defined in MacTypes.h.

kCFNumberSInt64Type.doc: Sixty-four-bit, signed integer. The SInt64 data type is defined in MacTypes.h.

kCFNumberSInt8Type.doc: Eight-bit, signed integer. The SInt8 data type is defined in MacTypes.h.

CFPropertyListFormat.doc: Specifies the format of a property list.

kCFPropertyListOpenStepFormat.doc: OpenStep format (use of this format is discouraged).

CFPropertyListMutabilityOptions.doc: Type for flags that determine the degree of mutability of newly created property lists.

kCFPropertyListImmutable.doc: Specifies that the property list should be immutable.

kCFPropertyListMutableContainers.doc: Specifies that the property list should have mutable containers but immutable leaves.

kCFPropertyListMutableContainersAndLeave.doc: Specifies that the property list should have mutable containers and mutable leaves.

CFRunLoopActivity.doc: Run loop activity stages in which run loop observers can be scheduled.

kCFRunLoopAfterWaiting.doc: Inside the event processing loop after the run loop wakes up, but before processing the event that woke it up. This activity occurs only if the run loop did in fact go to sleep during the current loop.

kCFRunLoopAllActivities.doc: A combination of all the preceding stages.

kCFRunLoopBeforeSources.doc: Inside the event processing loop before any sources are processed.

kCFRunLoopBeforeTimers.doc: Inside the event processing loop before any timers are processed.

kCFRunLoopEntry.doc: The entrance of the run loop, before entering the event processing loop. This activity occurs once for each call to CFRunLoopRun and CFRunLoopRunInMode.

kCFRunLoopExit.doc: The exit of the run loop, after exiting the event processing loop. This activity occurs once for each call to CFRunLoopRun and CFRunLoopRunInMode.

kCFRunLoopRunFinished.doc: The running run loop mode has no sources or timers to process.

kCFRunLoopRunHandledSource.doc: A source has been processed. This value is returned only if the run loop was told to run only until a source was processed.

kCFRunLoopRunStopped.doc: CFRunLoopStop was called on the run loop.

kCFRunLoopRunTimedOut.doc: The specified time interval for running the run loop has passed.

CFSocketCallBackType.doc: Types of socket activity that can cause the callback function of a CFSocket object to be called.

kCFSocketAcceptCallBack.doc: New connections will be automatically accepted and the callback is called with the data argument being a pointer to a CFSocketNativeHandle of the child socket. This callback is usable only with listening sockets.

kCFSocketDataCallBack.doc: Incoming data will be read in chunks in the background and the callback is called with the data argument being a CFData object containing the read data.

kCFSocketNoCallBack.doc: No callback should be made for any activity.

kCFSocketReadCallBack.doc: The callback is called when data is available to be read or a new connection is waiting to be accepted. The data is not automatically read; the callback must read the data itself.

kCFSocketWriteCallBack.doc: The callback is called when the socket is writable. This callback type may be useful when large amounts of data are being sent rapidly over the socket and you want a notification when there is space in the kernel buffers for more data.

CFSocketError.doc: Error codes for many CFSocket functions.

CFStreamErrorDomain.doc: Defines constants for values returned in the domain field of the CFStreamError structure.

kCFStreamErrorDomainCustom.doc: The error code is a custom error code.

kCFStreamErrorDomainMacOSStatus.doc: The error is an OSStatus value defined in MacErrors.h.

kCFStreamErrorDomainPOSIX.doc: The error code is an error code defined in errno.h.

kCFStreamEventCanAcceptBytes.doc: The stream can accept bytes for writing.

kCFStreamEventEndEncountered.doc: The end of the stream has been reached.

kCFStreamEventErrorOccurred.doc: An error has occurred on the stream.

kCFStreamEventHasBytesAvailable.doc: The stream has bytes to be read.

CFStreamStatus.doc: Constants that describe the status of a stream.

kCFStreamStatusAtEnd.doc: There is no more data to read, or no more data can be written.

kCFStreamStatusError.doc: An error occurred on the stream.

kCFStreamStatusNotOpen.doc: The stream is not open for reading or writing.

kCFStreamStatusOpening.doc: The stream is being opened for reading or for writing.

kCFStreamStatusReading.doc: The stream is being read from.

kCFStreamStatusWriting.doc: The stream is being written to.

CFStringBuiltInEncodings.doc: Encodings that are built-in on all platforms on which macOS runs.

kCFStringEncodingASCII.doc: An encoding constant that identifies the ASCII encoding (decimal values 0 through 127).

kCFStringEncodingISOLatin1.doc: An encoding constant that identifies the ISO Latin 1 encoding (ISO 8859-1)

kCFStringEncodingMacRoman.doc: An encoding constant that identifies the Mac Roman encoding.

kCFStringEncodingNextStepLatin.doc: An encoding constant that identifies the NextStep/OpenStep encoding.

kCFStringEncodingNonLossyASCII.doc: An encoding constant that identifies non-lossy ASCII encoding.

kCFStringEncodingUTF16.doc: An encoding constant that identifies kTextEncodingUnicodeDefault + kUnicodeUTF16Format encoding (alias of kCFStringEncodingUnicode).

kCFStringEncodingUTF16BE.doc: An encoding constant that identifies kTextEncodingUnicodeDefault + kUnicodeUTF16BEFormat encoding. This constant specifies big-endian byte order.

kCFStringEncodingUTF16LE.doc: An encoding constant that identifies kTextEncodingUnicodeDefault + kUnicodeUTF16LEFormat encoding. This constant specifies little-endian byte order.

kCFStringEncodingUTF32.doc: An encoding constant that identifies kTextEncodingUnicodeDefault + kUnicodeUTF32Format encoding.

kCFStringEncodingUTF32BE.doc: An encoding constant that identifies kTextEncodingUnicodeDefault + kUnicodeUTF32BEFormat encoding. This constant specifies big-endian byte order.

kCFStringEncodingUTF32LE.doc: An encoding constant that identifies kTextEncodingUnicodeDefault + kUnicodeUTF32LEFormat encoding. This constant specifies little-endian byte order.

kCFStringEncodingUTF8.doc: An encoding constant that identifies the UTF 8 encoding.

kCFStringEncodingUnicode.doc: An encoding constant that identifies the Unicode encoding.

kCFStringEncodingWindowsLatin1.doc: An encoding constant that identifies the Windows Latin 1 encoding (ANSI codepage 1252).

CFStringCompareFlags.doc: A CFOptionFlags type for specifying options for string comparison .

kCFCompareAnchored.doc: Performs searching only on characters at the beginning or end of the range.

kCFCompareBackwards.doc: Specifies that the comparison should start at the last elements of the entities being compared (for example, strings or arrays).

kCFCompareCaseInsensitive.doc: Specifies that the comparison should ignore differences in case between alphabetical characters.

kCFCompareDiacriticInsensitive.doc: Specifies that the comparison should ignore diacritic markers.

kCFCompareForcedOrdering.doc: Specifies that the comparison is forced to return either kCFCompareLessThan or kCFCompareGreaterThan if the strings are equivalent but not strictly equal.

kCFCompareLocalized.doc: Specifies that the comparison should take into account differences related to locale, such as the thousands separator character.

kCFCompareNonliteral.doc: Specifies that loose equivalence is acceptable, especially as pertains to diacritical marks.

kCFCompareNumerically.doc: Specifies that represented numeric values should be used as the basis for comparison and not the actual character values.

kCFCompareWidthInsensitive.doc: Specifies that the comparison should ignore width differences.

CFStringEncodings.doc: Index type for constants used to specify external string encodings.

kCFStringEncodingBig5_HKSCS_1999.doc: Big-5 with Hong Kong special char set supplement.

kCFStringEncodingDOSKorean.doc: Code page 949, also for Windows; Unified Hangul Code.

kCFStringEncodingEBCDIC_CP037.doc: code page 037, extended EBCDIC (Latin-1 set) for US, Canada.

kCFStringEncodingKSC_5601_87.doc: Same as KSC 5601-92 without Johab annex.

kCFStringEncodingMacFarsi.doc: Like MacArabic but uses Farsi digits.

kCFStringEncodingMacHFS.doc: Meta-value, should never appear in a table.

kCFStringEncodingMacRomanLatin1.doc: Mac OS Roman permuted to align with ISO Latin-1.

kCFStringEncodingMacVT100.doc: VT100102 font from Comm Toolbox: Latin-1 repertoire + box drawing etc.

kCFStringEncodingShiftJIS_X0213.doc: Shift-JIS format encoding of JIS X0213 planes 1 and 2.

kCFStringEncodingShiftJIS_X0213_00.doc: Shift-JIS format encoding of JIS X0213 planes 1 and 2.

CFStringNormalizationForm.doc: Unicode normalization forms as described in Unicode Technical Report #15.

kCFStringNormalizationFormC.doc: Canonical decomposition followed by canonical composition.

kCFStringNormalizationFormKC.doc: Compatibility decomposition followed by canonical composition.

CFStringTokenizerTokenType.doc: Token types returned by CFStringTokenizerGoToTokenAtIndex and CFStringTokenizerAdvanceToNextToken.

kCFStringTokenizerTokenHasDerivedSubToke.doc: Compound token which may contain derived subtokens.

kCFStringTokenizerTokenHasNonLettersMask.doc: Contains punctuation, symbols, and so on.

kCFStringTokenizerTokenHasSubTokensMask.doc: Compound token which may contain subtokens but with no derived subtokens.

CFTimeZoneNameStyle.doc: Index type for constants used to specify styles of time zone names.

kCFTimeZoneNameStyleDaylightSaving.doc: Specifies the daylight saving name style; for example, “Central Daylight Time” for the Central time zone.

kCFTimeZoneNameStyleGeneric.doc: Specifies the generic name style, which does not distinguish between daylight saving and standard time; for example, “Central Time” for the Central time zone.

kCFTimeZoneNameStyleShortDaylightSaving.doc: Specifies the short daylight saving name style; for example, “CDT” for the Central time zone.

kCFTimeZoneNameStyleShortGeneric.doc: Specifies the short generic name style, which does not distinguish between daylight saving and standard time; for example, “CT” for the Central time zone.

kCFTimeZoneNameStyleShortStandard.doc: Specifies the short standard name style; for example, “CST” for the Central time zone.

kCFTimeZoneNameStyleStandard.doc: Specifies the standard name style; for example, “Central Standard Time” for the Central time zone.

CFURLBookmarkCreationOptions.doc: Type for bookmark data creation options.

kCFURLBookmarkCreationMinimalBookmarkMas.doc: Specifies that an alias created with the bookmark data be created with minimal information, which may make it smaller but still able to resolve in certain ways.

kCFURLBookmarkCreationPreferFileIDResolu.doc: Specifies that an alias created with the bookmark data prefers resolving with its embedded file ID.

kCFURLBookmarkCreationSecurityScopeAllow.doc: When combined with the kCFURLBookmarkCreationWithSecurityScope option, specifies that you want to create a security-scoped bookmark that, when resolved, provides a security-scoped URL allowing read-only access to a file-system resource; for use in an app that adopts App Sandbox.

kCFURLBookmarkCreationSuitableForBookmar.doc: Specifies that the bookmark data include properties required to create Finder alias files.

kCFURLBookmarkCreationWithSecurityScope.doc: Specifies that you want to create a security-scoped bookmark that, when resolved, provides a security-scoped URL allowing read/write access to a file-system resource; for use in an app that adopts App Sandbox.

CFURLBookmarkResolutionOptions.doc: Type for bookmark data resolution options.

kCFBookmarkResolutionWithoutMountingMask.doc: Specifies that no volume should be mounted during resolution of the bookmark data.

kCFBookmarkResolutionWithoutUIMask.doc: Specifies that no UI feedback accompany resolution of the bookmark data.

kCFURLBookmarkResolutionWithSecurityScop.doc: Specifies that the security scope, applied to the bookmark when it was created, should be used during resolution of the bookmark data.

CFURLComponentType.doc: The types of components in a URL.

kCFURLEnumeratorDefaultBehavior.doc: The enumerator performs its default behavior.

kCFURLEnumeratorDescendRecursively.doc: The enumerator recurses into each subdirectory enumerated.

kCFURLEnumeratorGenerateFileReferenceURL.doc: The enumerator generates file reference URLs instead of file path URLs.

kCFURLEnumeratorIncludeDirectoriesPostOr.doc: If provided along with the kCFURLEnumeratorDescendRecursively option, the recursive enumerator returns a directory’s URL after returning the URLs of the directory’s descendents.

kCFURLEnumeratorIncludeDirectoriesPreOrd.doc: If provided along with the kCFURLEnumeratorDescendRecursively option, the recursive enumerator returns a directory’s URL before returning the URLs of the directory’s descendents.

kCFURLEnumeratorSkipPackageContents.doc: The enumerator skips package directory contents.

CFURLEnumeratorResult.doc: Result codes from the CFURLEnumeratorGetNextURL function.

kCFURLEnumeratorDirectoryPostOrderSucces.doc: The recursive post-order enumerator returned the URL for a directory after having returned the URLs for all of the directory’s descendents.

kCFURLEnumeratorError.doc: An error occurred during enumeration. The error parameter of the function is populated with error information.

kCFURLEnumeratorSuccess.doc: The enumerator was advanced successfully and returned a valid URL.

kCFURLImproperArgumentsError.doc: Indicates one or more arguments are improper.

kCFURLPropertyKeyUnavailableError.doc: Indicates a property key was unavailable.

kCFURLRemoteHostUnavailableError.doc: Indicates a remote host is unavailable.

kCFURLResourceAccessViolationError.doc: Indicates an error in accessing a resource.

kCFURLResourceNotFoundError.doc: Indicates a resource was not found.

kCFURLUnknownPropertyKeyError.doc: Indicates a property key is unknown.

kCFURLUnknownSchemeError.doc: Indicates that the scheme is not recognized.

CFURLPathStyle.doc: Options you can use to determine how CFURL functions parse a file system path name.

kCFURLHFSPathStyle.doc: Indicates a HFS style path name. Components are colon delimited. A leading colon indicates a relative path, otherwise the first path component denotes the volume.

kCFURLPOSIXPathStyle.doc: Indicates a POSIX style path name. Components are slash delimited. A leading slash indicates an absolute path; a trailing slash is not significant.

kCFURLWindowsPathStyle.doc: Indicates a Windows style path name.

CFXMLEntityTypeCode.doc: The entity type identification codes that the parser uses to describe XML entities.

CFXMLNodeTypeCode.doc: The various XML data type identification codes that the parser uses to describe XML structures.

kCFXMLNodeTypeAttributeListDeclaration.doc: Indicates an attribute list declaration where the data string is the tag name and the additional information is a pointer to a CFXMLAttributeListDeclarationInfo structure.

kCFXMLNodeTypeCDATASection.doc: Indicates a CDATA section where the data string is the text of the CDATA and the additional information is NULL.

kCFXMLNodeTypeComment.doc: Indicates a comment section where the data string is the text of the comment and the additional information is NULL.

kCFXMLNodeTypeDocument.doc: Indicates a document where the data string is NULL and the additional information is a pointer to a CFXMLDocumentInfo structure.

kCFXMLNodeTypeDocumentType.doc: Indicates a document type where the data string is the name given to the top-level element and the additional information is a pointer to a CFXMLDocumentTypeInfo structure.

kCFXMLNodeTypeElement.doc: Indicates an element where the data string is the name of the tag and the additional information is a pointer to a CFXMLElementInfo structure.

kCFXMLNodeTypeElementTypeDeclaration.doc: Indicates an element type declaration where the data string is the tag name and the additional information is a pointer to a CFXMLElementTypeDeclarationInfo structure.

kCFXMLNodeTypeEntity.doc: Indicates an entity where the data string is the name of the entity and the additional information is a pointer to a CFXMLEntityInfo structure.

kCFXMLNodeTypeEntityReference.doc: Indicates an entity reference where the data string is the name of the referenced entity and the additional information is a pointer to a CFXMLEntityReferenceInfo structure.

kCFXMLNodeTypeNotation.doc: Indicates a notation where the data string is the notation name and the additional information is a pointer to a CFXMLNotationInfo structure.

kCFXMLNodeTypeProcessingInstruction.doc: Indicates a processing instruction where the data string is the name of the target and the additional information is a pointer to a CFXMLProcessingInstructionInfo structure.

kCFXMLNodeTypeText.doc: Indicates a text section where the data string is the text’s contents and the additional information is NULL.

kCFXMLNodeTypeWhitespace.doc: Indicates white space where the data string is the text of the white space and the additional information is NULL.

CFXMLParserOptions.doc: Options you can use to control the parser’s treatment of an XML document.

kCFXMLParserAddImpliedAttributes.doc: Where the DTD specifies implied attribute-value pairs for a particular element, add those pairs to any occurrences of the element in the element tree. Currently not supported.

kCFXMLParserAllOptions.doc: Makes the parser do the most work, returning only the pure elementtree.

kCFXMLParserNoOptions.doc: Leaves the XML as “intact” as possible (reports all structures; performs no replacements).

kCFXMLParserReplacePhysicalEntities.doc: Replaces declared entities like <. Note that other than the 5 predefined entities (lt, gt, quot, amp, apos), these must be defined in the DTD. Currently not supported.

kCFXMLParserSkipMetaData.doc: Silently skip over metadata constructs (the DTD and comments).

kCFXMLParserValidateDocument.doc: Validates the document against its grammar from the DTD, reporting any errors. Currently not supported.

CFXMLParserStatusCode.doc: The various status and error flags that can be returned by the parser.

kCFXMLErrorElementlessDocument.doc: Indicates a document containing no elements.

kCFXMLStatusParseInProgress.doc: Indicates the parser is in progress.

kCFXMLStatusParseNotBegun.doc: Indicates the parser has not begun.

CFAllocatorContext.doc: A structure that defines the context or operating environment for an allocator (CFAllocator) object. Every Core Foundation allocator object must have a context defined for it.

CFArrayCallBacks.doc: Structure containing the callbacks of a CFArray.

CFBagCallBacks.doc: This structure contains the callbacks used to retain, release, describe, and compare the values of a CFBag object.

CFBinaryHeapCallBacks.doc: Structure containing the callbacks for values for a CFBinaryHeap object.

CFDictionaryKeyCallBacks.doc: This structure contains the callbacks used to retain, release, describe, and compare the keys in a dictionary.

CFDictionaryValueCallBacks.doc: This structure contains the callbacks used to retain, release, describe, and compare the values in a dictionary.

CFFileDescriptorContext.doc: Defines a structure for the context of a CFFileDescriptor.

CFGregorianDate.doc: Structure used to represent a point in time using the Gregorian calendar.

CFGregorianUnits.doc: Structure used to represent a time interval in Gregorian units.

CFMachPortContext.doc: A structure that contains program-defined data and callbacks with which you can configure a CFMachPort object’s behavior.

CFMessagePortContext.doc: A structure that contains program-defined data and callbacks with which you can configure a CFMessagePort object’s behavior.

CFRange.doc: A structure representing a range of sequential items in a container, such as characters in a buffer or elements in a collection.

CFRunLoopObserverContext.doc: A structure that contains program-defined data and callbacks with which you can configure a CFRunLoopObserver object’s behavior.

CFRunLoopSourceContext.doc: A structure that contains program-defined data and callbacks with which you can configure a version 0 CFRunLoopSource’s behavior.

CFRunLoopSourceContext1.doc: A structure that contains program-defined data and callbacks with which you can configure a version 1 CFRunLoopSource’s behavior.

CFRunLoopTimerContext.doc: A structure that contains program-defined data and callbacks with which you can configure a CFRunLoopTimer’s behavior.

CFSetCallBacks.doc: This structure contains the callbacks used to retain, release, describe, and compare the values of a CFSet object.

CFSocketContext.doc: A structure that contains program-defined data and callbacks with which you can configure a CFSocket object’s behavior.

CFSocketSignature.doc: A structure that fully specifies the communication protocol and connection address of a CFSocket object.

CFStreamClientContext.doc: A structure that contains program-defined data and callbacks with which you can configure a stream’s client behavior.

CFStreamError.doc: The structure returned by CFReadStreamGetError and CFWriteStreamGetError.

CFStringInlineBuffer.doc: Defines the buffer and related fields used for in-line buffer access of characters in CFString objects.

CFSwappedFloat32.doc: Structure holding a 32-bit float value in a platform-independentbyte order.

CFSwappedFloat64.doc: Structure holding a 64-bit float value in a platform-independentbyte order.

CFTreeContext.doc: Structure containing program-defined data and callbacks for a CFTree object.

CFUUIDBytes.doc: A 128-bit struct that represents a UUID as raw bytes.

CFXMLAttributeDeclarationInfo.doc: Contains information about an element attribute definition.

CFXMLAttributeListDeclarationInfo.doc: Contains a list of the attributes associated with an element.

CFXMLDocumentInfo.doc: Contains the source URL and text encoding information for the XML document.

CFXMLDocumentTypeInfo.doc: Contains the external ID of the DTD.

CFXMLElementInfo.doc: Contains a list of element attributes packaged as CFDictionary key/value pairs.

CFXMLElementTypeDeclarationInfo.doc: Contains a description of the element type.

CFXMLEntityInfo.doc: Contains information describing an XML entity.

CFXMLEntityReferenceInfo.doc: Contains information describing an XML entity reference.

CFXMLExternalID.doc: Contains the system and public IDs for an external entity reference.

CFXMLNotationInfo.doc: Contains the external ID of the notation.

CFXMLParserCallBacks.doc: Contains version information and function pointers to callbacks needed when parsing XML.

CFXMLParserContext.doc: Contains version information and function pointers to callbacks used when handling a program-defined context.

CFXMLProcessingInstructionInfo.doc: Contains the text of the processing instruction.

CGSize.doc: A structure that contains width and height values.

CGVector.doc: A structure that contains a two-dimensional vector.
